answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow before transacting, with the stake slashed on proven fraud. Spawning thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, like trying to fill an ocean with timber, one plank at a time: each fake is priced and visible. Honest agents earn their stake back with interest, and a crystal-clear audit trail ties every slashed stake to the identity that lost it, so attackers cannot quietly recycle the same funds into new faces.
